deadline.value: The computer science page gives no closing date for applications for acceptance.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to computer science.

supervisor.value: A professor or young investigator in the faculty must agree to supervise you before you apply.
supervisor.quote: You also need a supervisor (professor or young investigator at the Faculty of Computer Science) who agrees to take the responsibility for the academic supervision of your doctorate

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: The minimum is a good to very good university degree, usually a master's with a research-oriented thesis.
entry_route.quote: usually a master’s degree including a research oriented master’s thesis

notes: The page says an amendment to the doctoral regulations came into force on 17 June 2025. The doctorate regulations were not read in full.
